description: reels pile up behind your head, one every quarter second
numbered tiles fan out in an arc above your head
corner brackets snap onto your face and the camera follows you
your reels circle your head: in front at the bottom, behind you at the top
a fast punch-in on one word
a giant word drops in behind you
kill the lights, keep you lit
prints every instruction like a ticket, into the wall above your head
a moody colour grade: darker, softer, teal shadows
a before and after slider that sweeps across you
a checklist card beside your head that ticks off as you talk
a Follow button pops up and flips to Following
freeze the frame and point at something with a hand-drawn arrow
a glitchy uninstall bar that breaks the frame apart
your video shrinks into an Instagram reel card
keyboard keys rain down behind you
a big red stamp slams onto the screen
a 3, 2, 1 flip clock above your head
the frame tunnels into itself, spinning
you become a magazine cover, with the title behind your head
marker doodles draw themselves around you
black and white you, a giant purple word behind, kinetic type stacked beside you
a clean headline card slides down and pushes you into the bottom of the frame
a soft lavender backdrop, a giant word behind you and a profile card that gets followed
grid-paper room, your reels pinned behind you and blue pills that get clicked
a punch-in with a clean two-line headline, the second line in a white box
your profile grid fills the wall behind you while a counter ticks up
a tier list drops in front of you and Claude flies into S tier
split screen: b-roll on top with a price-tag sticker, you on the bottom
your reels fan out like a hand of phones in front of you, under a two-line headline
your shot builds itself out of glowing dots, then snaps into the full picture
a wall of your own reel headlines piles up behind your head, then your total views pop in front
a Claude task list builds under your chin: each step spins, then ticks green
frosted glass phone widgets and mini artifacts float around your head, with an Edited by Claude pill
a dark purple cinematic grade with an editing timeline, a REC timecode and a glowing playhead
an Instagram comments sheet above your head types your word, posts it, gets a heart and your reply
a liquid glass card floats under your chin while a graph climbs and the number counts up
your reels spin around you in a 3D carousel, then slow to a stop
news pages cut on one word, locked in place behind your head
an iPhone settings card under your chin flips its switches on, one line at a time
the lights drop and a glowing LED sign types itself out behind you
a slow cinematic push-in from the wide shot to your face, the room melting out of focus
the camera pushes into one top corner, a liquid glass graph pops beside your head, then the other corner with a second graph
iMessage notifications pop in one after another, creamy glass with a soft glow, stacking up above the bottom of the frame
you shrink into the centre tile of your 3x3 profile grid on frosted glass, then 8 of your reels pop in around you, one per frame, view counts on every tile
a strip of purple tape with your line lands on your chest
a purple selection box grabs your number and a cursor drags it bigger
the silent parts of your voice are trimmed away on screen until only your words are left
one huge serif word fills the wall behind you, then a red line crosses it out
a purple crayon writes your word behind your head, then underlines it
your reel covers deal into a fan behind your head, one card at a time
a glowing purple outline draws itself around you and pulses
your name and title wipe in at the bottom corner
a huge number counts up with a label and a hand-drawn underline
a step card: Step 2 of 4, the step title and a progress bar that fills
a search bar types your question, then the cursor clicks it
a pull-quote card: a big purple quote mark, your line typed word by word, and your name
a chapter card: a big purple number, a line that wipes in and the chapter title
two cards face off either side of a VS badge, then the winner lights up
a two-column card: green ticks for the pros, red crosses for the cons, one row at a time
a timeline of steps: the line fills left to right and each stop lights up with its label
the old price gets struck out in red and the new price slams in
two bars race: the long grey before against the short purple after
an AI chat box types your prompt, then the send button fires
a terminal window types your command and prints green ticks as each step finishes
a call to action: Comment the keyword and I'll send it, with a bouncing arrow
a MYTH card in red flips over to become the FACT in green
a news ticker slides up from the bottom and scrolls your headlines non-stop
live-stream reactions: hearts and emojis bubble up the side of the frame, swaying as they rise
three numbers count up side by side on one card, each with its label
your prompt goes up as a chat bubble, the AI thinks for a beat, then its answer streams in underneath
a titled list that reveals one numbered point at a time, the current one lit and the earlier ones dimmed
a social post card with your face, name and handle: the post writes itself, then the likes count up
a bar chart: your bars grow one after another, each with its value, the last one in purple
two stacked cards: the DON'T with a red cross, then the DO with a green tick, and the DON'T fades back
a review card: five stars light up one after another as the score counts up, with the number of reviews underneath
a pricing card: the plan name, the price, what is included ticking in line by line, and a button
the camera pushes in and moves you to one side, and a stat badge counts up in the space it opened
the camera pushes in and moves you aside, then a headline and three points appear one by one in the space
one giant number counts up across your chest in front of you, with a big label under it
two thick 3D emoji tiles sit behind your shoulders and a dotted path draws over your head from one to the other
a tilted purple graph panel hangs in 3D behind your shoulder while a smooth curve draws upward and its value counts
seven different emoji tiles drift in behind you from one side at different sizes, with your line on a pill
a wall of your keywords on tiles runs off into the distance behind you and slides slowly past
your points on a stack of cards tilted in 3D: the top card slides away to show the next
a 3D block turns a quarter turn for each of your points, one face per point
your keywords on cards circle your head in 3D: across your chest in front, behind your head at the back
a screen tilted in 3D shows your own dashboard: three numbers counting up over a row of rising bars
a dark full-screen hook: a glowing number, a headline, and three numbered pillars that rise and light up one by one
you shrink into a rounded frame while a notes panel opens beside you and ticks off your points
